answer: Sybil resistance can ride on commit-reveal participation: each epoch, agents first submit a sealed commitment to take part, then reveal it through a bridge of verifiable activity like attestations and grades. Missing the commitment window slides an identity toward its nadir — reputation decays even if the later reveal looks fine. Honest agents keep an oasis of steady liveness with one cheap step per epoch, but a puppeteer must run a perfect commit-reveal timetable for every clone; at scale, the scheduling burden multiplies and one missed slot exposes the whole farm.
